title: Cartwise Grocery Orders: Refunds on Items Sold by Weight Billed Over the Allowance
content:
# Items sold by weight billed over the allowance — Cartwise Grocery Orders

## Rule

On Cartwise Grocery Orders, produce, meat and deli sold by weight are billed on the weight handed over. When a line sold by weight is billed on more weight than its overage allowance permits, the weight-overage refund this rule computes is booked on that line with `refund_reason` `weight_overage`.

A weight-overage refund does not count toward the per-order self-service cap or the rolling limits.

## The rule at a glance

| What the order entries show | What the rule governs |
| --- | --- |
| A billed item line sold by weight whose billed weight is more than its overage allowance permits | A weight-overage refund on that same line, recorded with the reason `weight_overage` |
| A weight-overage refund standing on the order | It is not counted against the per-order self-service cap, and it is not counted in the customer's rolling refund limits |

## Points of judgement

- **Which line is refunded?** The billed item line sold by weight whose billed weight goes beyond its overage allowance; the refund is booked on that line and pays back that line's billed entry.
- **Does the refund use up the room the desk has for other item refunds on the order?** No. A weight-overage refund does not count toward the per-order self-service cap.
- **Does it add to the customer's rolling refund count or amount?** No. It does not count toward the rolling limits.

## Booking tool: `refund_weight_overage_a9b70a98`

### Capability

The tool books a refund on one billed item line of a Cartwise grocery order for a product sold by weight that was billed on more weight than the customer may be charged for. One call adds one item-refund entry to the order. The entry names the order line and the billed line entry it pays back, carries the controlled refund reason and the refunded amount, and returns the money to the customer's original payment method, lowering the net amount billed on the order by that amount. The refund shows at once among the order's entries with today's date.

### How it is invoked

The tool is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `refund_weight_overage_a9b70a98` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `customer_id` | The customer reference number of the person who placed the order, read from the customer profile lookup | Id |
| `order_id` | The order number of the grocery order being refunded, read from the order lookup | Id |
| `line_number` | The position of the refunded item line on the order, exactly as shown on the billed line entry | Integer (1, 2, 3 ...), no decimals |
| `source_event_id` | The reference number of the billed item line entry (the line charge) this refund pays back, read from the order entries lookup | Id |
| `refund_reason` | The controlled reason recorded on the refund | Exactly one of the literals listed below |
| `amount_usd` | The amount refunded on the line, in USD | Positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; never 0 or negative |

The literals `refund_reason` accepts are:

- `missing` — the billed product never reached the customer;
- `damaged` — the product arrived broken, crushed or leaking;
- `wrong_item` — a different product from the one ordered or approved was handed over;
- `quality` — the product arrived spoiled, expired or otherwise unfit;
- `substitution_rejected` — the customer turned down a delivered replacement product;
- `substitution_price_protection` — the replacement was billed above the protected price of the original;
- `weight_overage` — a product sold by weight was billed above the allowed weight;
- `alcohol_id_failed` — alcohol lines were taken back because the ID check at handoff failed;
- `returned_order` — the whole order went back to the store undelivered;
- `late_delivery` — a fee returned because the order completed late (fee refunds only);
- `item_refund_share` — the service fee share returned with item refunds (fee refunds only).

### Return

A receipt with these fields: `order_event_id` (the reference number of the new refund entry), `order_id` (the order refunded), `line_number` (the refunded line), `refund_reason` (the reason recorded), `refund_destination` (always `original_payment_method`), `amount_usd` (the amount booked, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status`, which reads "booked" when the refund entry now stands on the order.
